pharma.title: NPPA to revise internal guidelines for processing overcharging cases

mcqs.q: Under the newly launched PM RAHAT Scheme, what is the maximum cashless treatment coverage provided for road accident victims during the golden hour?
mcqs.explanation: The PM RAHAT Scheme launched by the Central Government offers cashless emergency medical treatment up to ₹1.5 lakh (₹1,50,000) for road accident victims during the critical golden hour.

mcqs.q: What exemption period has the National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) granted to antiseptic throat spray formulations from DPCO pricing rules?

mcqs.q: Which state government launched the specialized quick-response disaster force named 'Arjun Vahini'?
